scope.candidate_market_rule: Use one saved row per non-null Gamma condition_id with market_start inside the frozen development interval and all A/B/C/D probabilities present. Keep rows without Gamma condition_id as no-market-mapping coverage records; do not turn them into trades.

preliminary_identity_audit.official_label_count_source: Existing E0031/E0036 canonical record; re-count only as label-status coverage after protocol freeze

scope.holdout_filter: Exclude market_start_utc >= 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z before any join or projection of label columns; do not open the holdout match file.

candidate_identity.readiness_timestamp: Not present per prediction row. Do not create synthetic telemetry. Treat nominal T-60 availability as an assumption and results as retrospective/conditional unless the full saved lineage proves stricter causality.

pmxt_archive.holdout_parts_rule: Do not read event partitions whose UTC hour begins at or after 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z.

old_limited_pmxt_market_index.interpretation: Older saved index boundary, not the physical PMXT archive end; use the full frozen development cutoff.

obadiaha.capture_semantics: 10-second sampled CLOB /book snapshots; native token IDs; top 10 levels; one timestamp without independent event/receive time. Proxy only: nearest prior snapshot no older than 10 seconds; no cross-market carry.

kachoio.capture_semantics: 1-second within-market BBO samples with displayed size and no ask depth, observed 2026-03-24T22:10Z through 2026-05-18T10:34:59Z. Prior source audit found no rows at or before T-60/T-59; reconfirm as a negative pre-open coverage control.

source_only_smoke_tests.selection_rule: Earliest saved PMXT candidate strictly after E0036's maximum start; time/source only, no outcomes or PnL.
checks: BBO reconciliation and T-59 quality reason

source_only_smoke_tests.selection_rule: Earliest Obadiaha market in March source coverage with both native books sampled no more than 10 seconds before both cutoffs; time/source only, no outcomes or PnL.
checks: prior sample age at both cutoffs
top-10 level order and depth walk

entry_policy.candidate_probabilities: Use unchanged E0031 saved A/B/C/D values. Nominal decision time is T-60. Missing prediction_available_at_utc stays missing; no invented runtime timestamp.
entry_policy.side_selection: At T-60 calculate expected net payout for UP/DOWN using native best ask, displayed size, and frozen fee regime at the requested gross. Require a full single-level fill and strictly positive expected net payout; choose the greater value, exact tie toward UP. At T-59 walk only the chosen native ask ladder; accept full fills only.
entry_policy.free_cash_basis: Cash at T-60 after releasing only positions whose scenario payout time has passed.
entry_policy.below_minimum_sizing: Reject requested gross below the frozen minimum; never raise a request such as $4.75 to $5.00.
entry_policy.fees: Preserve existing V1 share-fee/V2 cash-fee and precision behavior once; T-60 fee for decision EV, T-59 fee for execution. No sale or payout fee.

minimum_order_audit.change_rule: Do not change the fallback or sizing absent dated authoritative evidence and an explicit recorded decision.

payout_sensitivity.resolved_at_semantics: Gamma resolution metadata; actual outcome observation and redemption availability are not archived. None of the delays is claimed actual or conservative.
payout_sensitivity.accounting: Rerun each chronological $100 path separately per delay. Release only when scenario availability passes; retain unsettled positions/cost at development cutoff.

cohorts.e0036_parity: Reproduce the unchanged 1,143-market control; investigate any difference before interpreting extended results.
cohorts.pmxt_exact: One chronological replay for all candidate Gamma IDs and both cutoffs, development event parts only. T-60 needs usable native BBO/displayed size; T-59 needs valid native ask depth sufficient for the requested notional. Enforce receive/source cutoffs, known fees, no complementary liquidity, and no undocumented archive gaps after book/fee initialization. Report only coverage-conditional accounts; missing-source opportunities remain unknown, never silently no-trade.
cohorts.obadiaha_proxy: Separate March 1-19 cohort using nearest prior sample no older than 10 seconds at each cutoff and both native top-10 books. Top-10 depth shortfall is unknown depth, not proven no liquidity. Do not merge with PMXT or E0036.
cohorts.kachoio: Verify pre-open availability; if its ticks still begin at market start, retain only as a negative source-coverage control; no T-59 depth is available.

coverage_manifest.reporting: Monthly funnel and exact first-exclusion counts, preserving all later quality flags. No-Gamma-ID calendar rows get a separate no-market-mapping count. Distinguish full Gamma development, official-label, prediction, reconstructed, and common evaluable denominators.

outputs.local_ladders_ledgers: Ignored data/analysis only; do not commit raw data, checkpoints, model binaries, caches, or bulky output.

analysis_limits.provenance_conclusion: If full-pipeline fold-local independence cannot be proven from saved evidence, report retrospective/conditional economics only; preserve E0024 historical status and do not imply independent validation or holdout authorization.

validation_gate.before_economic_results: Pass both declared source-only smoke checks and E0036 parity; verify selected hashes and development filters.
validation_gate.tests: Add focused independent-example regressions for requested invariants; run focused and relevant full test suites after code changes.
validation_gate.t0009_close: Remain blocked while material development source/provenance gaps persist; a manifest or positive conditional subset is insufficient.
